Actor James Marsden, who recently played billionaire Owen Ashe in the second season of Your Friends & Neighbors, has this week confirmed his third Apple TV project. Here's what we know.

Apple TV is working on a new mystery comedy

Earlier this year, Apple Studios confirmed that James Marsden (Paradise, X-Men: Days of Future Past) would play CIA case officer Brad Griffin in the upcoming thriller Disavowed.

The news came just weeks before the premiere of Your Friends & Neighbors season 2, in which he plays billionaire Owen Ashe.

According to Deadline (via MacMagazine), Marsden has now confirmed his third Apple TV project, this time a mystery comedy called Bad News Dads.

Here's what Deadline had to say:

As with Disavowed, Marsden will also serve as an executive producer. Deadline adds that the show is "created by You're the Worst creator Stephen Falk."

The report notes that Frost's source novel Bad News Dads is scheduled for publication on April 6, 2027, while the half-hour Apple TV mystery comedy adaptation is still in development and no premiere date has been announced.

For the full Deadline report, head here.

Apple TV is $12.99 a month, or available via an Apple One bundle. The platform offers a host of popular shows and movies, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.
